records.title: Vortices in a trapped dilute Bose-Einstein condensate
records.venue: Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter 13 (2001) R135-R194
records.topic: GPE vortex structure, energy, dynamics, normal modes, stability, vortex arrays
records.relevance: Primary GPE reference for the QuantumLab 1D/2D/3D solver and BEC vortex physics.

records.title: Vortices in a trapped dilute Bose-Einstein condensate
records.topic: Same work as the J. Phys.: Condens. Matter review; preprint form.
records.relevance: Same as the published version; useful for cross-checking pagination and equations.

records.title: Imaging the decay of quantized vortex rings to decipher quantum dissipation
records.topic: Quantized vortex rings in He II; Schwarz / two-way / self-consistent two-way models; mutual friction
records.relevance: Bridge into 3D vortex-ring dynamics and dissipation; NOT a single-component GPE validation.

records.title: Turbulence in Quantum Gases: Vortices, Waves, and Cascades
records.topic: Review: quantum turbulence, vortex dynamics, waves, cascades in ultracold gases
records.relevance: Literature map for later numerical and experimental vortex work in the GPE setting.

records.title: Vortex solution in elliptic coordinates
records.topic: Exact elliptical vortex solution of the Euler equations; elliptic-coordinate transformations
records.relevance: Geometric / mathematical reference (metric factors, differential geometry), not a quantum-vortex solution.

records.title: Numerical analysis of vortex dynamics in hyperbolic funnels using computational fluid dynamics
records.topic: 3D structured meshes, volume-of-fluid multiphase modelling, Euler-Euler, SST turbulence with curvature correction
records.relevance: Classical vortex geometry and CFD methodology; separate from quantum-simulation validation.

records.title: Theory of Bose-Einstein condensation in trapped gases
records.venue: Reviews of Modern Physics 71, 463 (1999); arXiv preprint 1998
records.topic: Mean-field theory of trapped BEC; GPE, collective modes, stability

records.title: Bose-Einstein condensates with vortices in rotating traps
records.topic: Minimal-energy vortex solutions in rotating traps; Thomas-Fermi variational Ansatz; vortex stabilisation

records.title: A new self-consistent approach of quantum turbulence in superfluid helium
records.topic: FOUCAULT model: vortex-filament superfluid coupled to a modified Navier-Stokes normal fluid
records.relevance: Self-consistent two-fluid quantum-turbulence modelling; not a single-component GPE validation.
